meta.name: pixverse
meta.description: Generate, extend, compose and edit videos with PixVerse models via inference.sh CLI. Models: PixVerse V6, C1, Extend, Fusion, Modify, Lip Sync, Avatar, plus PixVerse Lipsync on fal.ai. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, 360p-1080p, 5-15s, video continuation, multi-subject composition from reference images, text-guided video editing with masks and reference images, lip sync from audio or TTS, talking avatars from a portrait. Use for: social clips, longer sequences built by extension, putting specific people, products or pets into one scene, swapping subjects in footage, dubbing, talking presenters. Triggers: pixverse, pixverse v6, pixverse c1, pixverse extend, pixverse fusion, pixverse modify, pixverse lipsync, pixverse lip sync, pixverse avatar, extend video, video continuation, compose subjects video, reference to video
